purpose: Traceable late Wave 2 cross-agent taxonomy/difficulty/timing review of an available representative batch. These are independent Gauss records; they do not mutate author branches or claim H/I approvals.

portfolioLevelFindings.finding: All 22 candidates reuse one WHOLE_TIMING object and one opening/core/transfer STAGE_TIMING table. Those values are author planning defaults, not family calibration, and cannot be approved as timingCalibration.

All 19 candidates reuse one FAMILY_TIMING and one five-position STAGE_TIMING table. The helper also derives core role mechanically from the first interior stage at the author core band. Both choices need family-specific independent review before calibration.

Cantor uses per-family low-confidence timing rather than a shared template. The reviewed high-calibration-risk families still run past the public whole-interview anchor and need shorter soft cutoffs, but the authoring shape is suitable for independent calibration.

rationale.domains: The family genuinely moves among algebraic factorization, function preimages, derivative/turning-point structure, and graphical horizontal-line geometry.
rationale.contentConcepts: Each listed concept is directly exercised by a milestone; the two distinct parameter thresholds make roots/intersections and extrema separately material.
rationale.prerequisiteConcepts: Basic factorization, graph language, and differentiation are assumed without teaching; the parameter classification itself is assessed.
rationale.reasoningSkills: The family measures factorization, representation changes, case analysis and precision. guided-adaptation may be elicited by the staged hint path but remains process-grounded and is intentionally absent from milestone claims.

stageAssessments.rationale: Factoring the divided difference and filling the removable hole are accessible to a prepared candidate but require clean algebra and a derivative connection.
The core must distinguish discriminant regimes and the separate stationary-point threshold without confusing multiplicity with distinct inputs.
The scaled-cubic and secant-sign extensions deepen the same mechanism but do not add enough conceptual burden to justify a stretch difficulty band.

rationale.domains: The recurrence is the primary object; the asymptotic squeeze is elementary analysis, with algebra used to expose the squared update.
rationale.contentConcepts: The family measures monotone growth, an almost-telescoping squared recurrence, quantitative bounds and a normalized limiting argument.
rationale.prerequisiteConcepts: Basic sequence and limit reasoning is assumed. A logarithmic/harmonic comparison should be supplied or developed if the candidate has not seen it; it should not silently become an extra prerequisite.
rationale.reasoningSkills: The key reasoning switch is from a_n to a_n^2, followed by a nontrivial cumulative-error bound. guided-adaptation is process-only and not milestone-grounded.

stageAssessments.rationale: Positivity, monotonicity and the squared update are accessible once the right representation is suggested.
The core difficulty is proving the accumulated reciprocal-square error is sublinear rather than merely positive or O(n).
General c and the plausible logarithmic correction provide genuine transfer beyond the leading-order proof.

rationale.domains: The process combines Euclidean divisibility with connected-graph propagation.

rationale.prerequisiteConcepts: Elementary arithmetic/divisibility and graph vocabulary are assumed. The global invariant/monovariant construction is assessed.
rationale.reasoningSkills: The family primarily measures finding a descent monovariant and a preserved gcd, then joining them in a proof.

stageAssessments.rationale: Small paths reduce immediately to repeated subtraction and should function as an accessible opening.
The central work is identifying both the strictly decreasing sum and global gcd invariant, then using connectivity.
Disconnected components and differing move-sequence lengths deepen precision but remain within the same standard mechanism.

rationale.domains: The family is a coordinate/Euclidean locus problem with essential algebraic elimination.
rationale.contentConcepts: The swept-locus condition, circle equation and geometric interpretation all directly exercise the proposed content.
rationale.prerequisiteConcepts: Basic coordinates, diameter-circle geometry and algebra are assumed; parameter elimination/topology are assessed.
rationale.reasoningSkills: The core reasoning is a sketch-to-equation representation switch followed by an existence interval test and geometric re-interpretation.

stageAssessments.rationale: Sketching several admissible circles is deliberately accessible.
Deriving x^2+y^2=ax+by is a coordinate technique check, not the substantive core.
Turning existence of a circle through a point into an interval/sign condition is the central insight.
Interpreting the sign product correctly as the closure of the symmetric difference requires care.
General lambda,L and strict-endpoint behavior provide a genuine parameter/topology transfer.

rationale.domains: The decisive object is an injective affine self-map of a finite set. Set-theory/set-maps is a better canonical fit than combinatorics/counting.
rationale.contentConcepts: The proof does not count configurations; it turns the definition into a finite self-map and uses contraction of centered iterates. set-maps therefore replaces counting-structure.
rationale.prerequisiteConcepts: Set notation is the relevant assumed language; counting-principles are not materially required. Basic function/algebra language is assumed.
rationale.reasoningSkills: The family is definition-led, then requires an affine representation switch and a finite-orbit/contraction abstraction.

stageAssessments.rationale: Two-element examples make the new definition approachable.
Encoding the rule as T(x)=(sigma-x)/(n-1) is the setup, not yet the central proof.
Recognizing injective finite self-map => permutation and combining that with strict contraction is the main conceptual barrier.
Separating n=2 from n>2 and closing the distinctness contradiction requires precision.
The include-self and multiset variants deepen the definition but stay within the same abstraction level.

stageAssessments.rationale: Examples should be short.
Form the affine map and center it at the mean.
Allow time for the permutation-plus-contraction insight.
Boundary n=2 and distinctness close the proof.
Extensions are optional.
